intro: Stars of Elune marks a major milestone in a young night elf priest's communion with the Moon Goddess. Upon proving their dedication to their people, acolytes are invited to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus to learn sacred arts unique to the Sisterhood of Elune.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've proven yourself worthy of Elune's attention. If you feel you're ready, I would very much like to teach you one of her spells unique to our people.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
